decisions.reason: The ceiling or floor pipe bracket remains close to the core pipeline business, matches existing fabrication capabilities, and is the kind of practical add-on product the firm's customer base is likely to continue buying.
The pipe support bracket fits the firm's established offer and infrastructure customers very well, so it is likely to stay unless demand proves persistently too small.

The powder-coated public waste bin is comparatively far from the firm's core water and pipeline range, and as a single distant product it is a plausible candidate to discontinue in order to focus resources.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray line is outside the core range but its several models suggest a more deliberate offering that can still leverage the firm's coating and metalworking strengths for municipal buyers.
Standalone outdoor public ashtrays are a peripheral niche for this firm and are easier to cut when concentrating on stronger core products and the more developed waste-bin line.
